# STMP (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 3 measured or mapped, 3 mapped, 0 excluded, 0 unmapped, 28 not measured

## Measurements

STMP.OpCntRs | operation-count | supervision.opcntrs
STMP.Tmp | temperature | unit degC | stmp.tmp
STMP.TmpRte | temperature-rate | unit K/s | stmp.tmprte

## Data objects

Tmp MV (STMP): mapped stmp.tmp
